name: followup_news
description: Stage 5: Optionally weave recent news into an existing follow-up message
content:
You have a follow-up message draft and recent news about the prospect's company or industry.

DRAFT MESSAGE:
{draft_message}

NEWS CONTEXT:
{news_context}

{voice_rules}

TASK: Rewrite the message to naturally reference the news. Rules:
- Reference news ONLY if genuinely relevant to the conversation
- Keep it brief — one mention, not a summary of the article
- Maintain the original tone and voice
- Keep under {symbols_limit} characters
- If the news isn't relevant, return the original message unchanged
- Do NOT mention the source, article title, or link
- Do NOT say "I read that" or "I noticed" — weave it naturally
- Do NOT use em dashes
- Do NOT add any company names, role titles, or industry buzzwords unless the brief or stance requires that fact

Return ONLY the final message text, nothing else.
